title: Update The town's land round Spindle Lane
notes: Direct user request, 2026-11-02: the surrounding background looks too fake. Use fewer houses and more believable gardens and connecting streets. Continue the stair railings and guard visible drops. Deliberately edit the adopted master, retain its heights, tread and power-channel geometry, and update the area-owned scenery placements.
